title: Build layer: Mac OS 8.6
note: Mac OS 8.6 as baked from Apple's installer (os-8.6) with the tools every other bake needs in the guest: CarbonLib 1.6 (in the System Folder), StuffIt Expander 6.0.1 (expand bakes; the System's own 5.x stays in Internet Utilities) and Disk Copy (floppy sets, disk images), in Utilities. PowerPC only. The base for 8.6 bakes (bases.json tools-8.6).
